meta.note: Per-state values are ESTIMATED allocations of sourced national totals; replace with FCC LMS / Medill state data when available.

sources.title: Medill Local News Initiative, The State of Local News 2024 (national total ~5,600 newspapers, 80% weeklies; per-state values ESTIMATED by allocation)
FCC Public Notice DA 26-49, Broadcast Station Totals as of Dec 31, 2025 (AM 4,342; FM comm 6,589; FM edu 4,755; full-power TV 1,777)
Pew Research Center, Americans' Changing Relationship With Local News (May 2024) and Sept 2024 short read (local TV 64%)
Pew, Consumption and sources of local political news (Jul 2024; local outlets 66% overall, 75% age 65+, 53% age 18-29)

byAge.estimated: All age-band shares estimated from Pew's published age gaps (local political news from local outlets: 53% age 18-29 vs 75% age 65+; very-close following 9% vs 35%); not exact Pew figures.

estimated.journalistsPerTvStationNewsroom: estimated ~35 from RTDNA/Hofstra survey typical average; not retrieved
